en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of lectures is to get basic information about interior furnishing wit ability to satisfy requirements on quality living in conection na wide living surrounding, interior items and operating activities. Enlarge aesthetic feeling in conection with living.
